intent.core_idea: Shared truth persists and evolves without erasing history.
intent.emotional_outcome: Confidence that consequential state can be verified, shared and corrected.
intent.functional_truth: A durable typed graph lets agents create, retrieve and update connected records while provenance, relationships, prior versions and disagreement remain inspectable.
proof_cues: Effective time distinguishes when a claim applies from when it was recorded or corrected.
intent.sibling_distinction: Neotoma preserves what is true and how it changed; Ateles governs who can act.

positioning.product_promise: A durable shared record graph where agents can establish, retrieve, and correct consequential state without erasing provenance or prior versions.
positioning.sibling_role: Neotoma answers what was true; Ateles answers who was authorized.

contrast.requirement: Meet WCAG contrast for text and meaningful graphics in every approved colorway; media copy needs a tested safe field.

images_of_text.requirement: Use semantic text; only essential logotypes may be images of text and need accessible names.

cinematic.palette_and_material: Warm archival paper, deep ink, teal record continuity, amber only for correction or supersession, archival glass/vellum/mineral materials.
prohibitions: database cylinder, cloud, brain, or generic AI glow
generated text, UI, faces, hands, or avatars
correction as the entire brand story
cinematic.semantics: A durable record graph receives distinct create, retrieve, and update operations while provenance, relationships, and prior state remain intact; correction propagates without erasing history.

delivery.hero: One silent 8-second 4:3 master, 720p or better, with H.264 and VP9/AV1 web encodes; each hero asset under 1.8 MB.
delivery.responsive: Provide 16:9 desktop and art-directed 9:16 mobile crops without losing the semantic beat.
delivery.sections: Five-to-six-second silent 16:9 masters or still-led micro-loops; target under 900 KB per moving web asset and under 150 KB per AVIF poster.

aesthetic_territory.identity: A persistent graph rendered as an archive rather than a dashboard. Create adds a durable object and relationship; retrieve illuminates without mutation; update adds a current layer while prior state remains visible.
aesthetic_territory.name: Living archive of connected truth
aesthetic_territory.originality_basis: Distinctiveness comes from product truth—durable typed records, source provenance, registered relationships, version history, correction, explicit disagreement, deterministic current state, and create/retrieve/update across tools.
aesthetic_territory.palette_material_light: Archival paper and deep ink; teal for continuity and durable relation; amber only for correction or supersession; vellum, archival glass, mineral record tiles, raking light, and restrained depth.
aesthetic_territory.product_truth: Neotoma is the designated record for agent-generated state, preserving typed records and relationships, provenance, disagreement, current value, prior state, and correction across agents and tools.

aesthetic_territory.scope_statement: Internal creative platform subordinate to the settled category “The system of record for AI agents.” It is not an alternate category noun, public headline, or tagline.
aesthetic_territory.summary: A persistent typed record graph becomes a material archive whose sources, relationships, current values, prior states, disagreement, and agent operations remain inspectable.
aesthetic_territory.typography_layout: Editorial serif for durable shared-truth statements, neutral productive body, and monospace only for short reader-recognizable source/version/status labels; cinematic material fields dominate.

anti_patterns: Never expose internal record IDs, entity types, field or decision keys, code-call names, repository filenames, phase bookkeeping, or agent instructions on a public page.

Do not paste research analysis, source citations, or implementation-review notes into public prose. Keep detailed evidence in linked source artifacts and translate it into a short reader-facing proof statement.
Do not turn the provenance rail into developer marginalia. Every visible label must be understandable to a cold external reader without product-internal vocabulary.
Do not spread the correction color as a general accent; reserve it for a superseded value or correction event.
Do not rely on animation to communicate source, version, correction, disagreement, or refresh; reduced-motion and static views must remain complete.
Do not diverge shared structural tokens from Ateles without a product reason; the products remain siblings through spacing, restraint, and hierarchy.
Do not reuse the Neotoma app or Inspector palette. Public product pages keep their distinct paper, ink, teal, and correction system.
visual_styles.camera: Locked or slow macro dolly with layered parallax that reveals lineage and relationship depth while persistent geometry stays registered.
visual_styles.composition: Cinematic graph fields dominate, with calm copy-safe negative space. Supporting diagrams may clarify lineage and mechanism but do not replace cinematic identity.
visual_styles.light: Soft museum darkness, raking daylight, restrained volumetric dust; the graph feels durable rather than digital vapor.
